task_definition.task_description: I have a sequence of tasks for you. First, check the weather in Tokyo and look up the gate board details for flight CA1234. Next, publish a high-priority gate board notice on the app for user usr_98765. After that, archive the moderate "Flight Weather Alert" card (alert ID wa_001) for the same user via the app, and build a high-priority contact alert payload for Alice Chen with the message "Flight Weather Alert". Finally, get a workplace room pass for at least 2 people on January 16, 2026, starting at 09:00, and fetch the latest business news.
